newsitem.title: USA: Durham, N.C, puts $86.3 million GOs on ballot.
newsitem.headline: Durham, N.C, puts $86.3 million GOs on ballot.

text.p: Durham, N.C., City Council voted to put five general obligation bond issues totalling $86.3 million on the Nov 5 ballot, city officials said Tuesday.

Voters will be asked to approve $35.2 million for streets, $20.4 million for parks and recreation, $20 million for housing, $5.5 million for arts and museum use and $5.2 million for public transportation.
The council approved the referendums on Monday despite a request from Mayor Sylvia Kerckhoff that it be delayed until spring to allow more time to educate voters about the proposals.
The proposals would raise the city's property tax rate by six cents per $100 of assessed value by 2003, assuming no expansion of the tax base.
